title: The PR’s required merge ordering relies on shared artifacts dropping from #118, but this copy is not identical
text: The PR’s required merge ordering relies on shared artifacts dropping from #118, but this copy is not identical to #118: this file adds an EOF newline while #118 removes it (and `sweep-real-pr-evidence.md` likewise differs). Merging #119 first therefore leaves #118 with residual changes that reverse this PR’s corrections. Synchronize #118 to these exact blobs before this PR lands, or remove the shared artifacts from this PR and correct the stated split.
rationale: Cross-PR merge-ordering concern (blob differences against sibling PR #118); outside what a single-PR reviewer can see. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
